published.source: Paladin PR (client 70425: Judgement of Righteousness 42.9%, Champion of the Light 10 / 20 / 30%, Consecration 4.2% a tick, 2026-10-16)

summary: The sub Holy twist build with Holy Conduit 2 against an Undead or Demon boss, with Exorcism and Holy Wrath in the rotation. The best paladin build on such a boss at 300 s; the Shock build is ahead at 120 s and level at 180 s.
advantage: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only work on Undead and Demons, so against such a boss they're extra damage on top of the usual rotation. This build also takes Holy Conduit 2, which makes both spells 40% cheaper.
advantageShort: Exorcism and Holy Wrath hit only Undead and Demons: extra damage on top of the rotation. Holy Conduit 2 makes both 40% cheaper.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -3 s, Seal of Command at -1.5 s so the first swing gets the Echo
Consecration on cooldown while mana is at or above 20%
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Command whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Command up, swap to Seal of Righteousness in the last 1.5 s before a swing, and back to Command before the next swing (one swap per swing, down to 20% mana); Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only land on Undead and Demons, so this build only applies to those bosses

Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 spell power and 18 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
0.5% behind the default at 120 s and 0.8% at 300 s because it has no Precision
Would gain 1.4 DPS twisting down to 0% mana, but shares the twist rotation's 20% floor
Holy Strike's flat part inside the 50% weapon percent comes from client data, not yet confirmed on the beta
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be stale: holding them to their level 30 trend would cost about 1.2%
Seal of Righteousness spell power counted twice on a two-hander (SoD-style 2 x 11%); one coefficient would be about 50-54 DPS lower, and client 70425's 0 on the proc spells about 98-105 lower
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization applied to Holy seal damage (Era sim choice vs client Physical mask): about -11 if removed
Synthetic gear on the hybrid budget (only the Justice Battlegear 2-piece live)
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as paladin__level_60_sub_holy except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeUndead, as the class preset's encounter does.
